grammar.label: ergative verbs — the door opened, she opened the door
grammar.form: same verb, transitive with an agent and intransitive without one
grammar.meaning: lets an event be described with or without the person who caused it

explanation.en: 'The window broke' and 'he broke the window' use one verb. The intransitive version is not passive — there is no 'was' — but it has the same effect of removing the agent. Not every verb does this: 'the road built' is wrong, because 'build' is not ergative. Which verbs allow it has to be learnt item by item.
explanation.uz: 'The window broke' va 'he broke the window' — bir fe'l. O'timsiz shakl majhul nisbat EMAS, lekin bajaruvchini yashiradi. Hamma fe'l bunday emas: 'the road built' xato.

grammar.positive_example: The talks broke down in the second week; nobody has said who walked out.
grammar.negative_example: The talks were broken down in the second week.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida o'zlik va majhul nisbat qo'shimchalar bilan aniq farqlanadi; ingliz tilida bir xil so'z ishlatilishi chalkashtiradi.

grammar.label: causatives at C1 — have, get, make, let and their differences
grammar.form: have / get + object + past participle; have / make / let + object + base verb; get + object + to-infinitive
grammar.meaning: says who arranged an action rather than who performed it

explanation.en: 'I had the roof repaired' — I arranged it. 'I got the roof repaired' — the same, with more effort implied. 'I had him repair it' — I directed a person. 'I got him to repair it' — I persuaded one. 'Make' compels, 'let' permits. The pattern after each verb is fixed and different, and choosing the wrong one changes who did what.
explanation.uz: 'I had the roof repaired' — men tashkil qildim. 'I got him to repair it' — ko'ndirdim. Har bir fe'ldan keyingi qurilma boshqacha, va noto'g'ri tanlash kim nima qilganini o'zgartiradi.

grammar.positive_example: She got the registrar to release the file by asking three times.
grammar.negative_example: She got the registrar release the file by asking three times.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida orttirma nisbat (-tir, -dir) bitta qo'shimcha bilan beriladi; ingliz tilida besh xil qurilma bor.
